name: Samurai Sword
summary: Hidden-role team combat game where Shogun, Samurai, Ninja and Ronin attack with distance-limited weapons to steal honor.
rules_text: Players get a secret Role: Shogun (public), Samurai, Ninja, or Ronin. Each gets a face-up Character giving max resilience and a power, starting resilience tokens and 3-5 Honor Points. Shuffle 90 Weapon/Property/Action cards as deck; deal 4-7 cards increasing around table. On your turn: if you have 0 resilience you recover all; draw 2 cards; play any number of cards but at most one Weapon to attack. Weapon has max difficulty and damage. Difficulty to target someone is seating distance, skipping Harmless players, plus Armor they have. Defender may discard a parry card to cancel. If damage reduces resilience to 0, you are Defeated, become Harmless until your next turn, and give one Honor Point to attacker. A player with no cards or no resilience is Harmless and cannot be weapon-targeted. When any player loses their last Honor Point, game ends and winning team(s) score by surviving and honor.
rating_reason: Hidden roles Bang variant, roles_with_allies, turn-based strategy.
